nom: cocokind Milky-Soft Face and Body Wash

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report the cleanser removes oil and makeup without leaving a film or over-drying, though one notes it does not fully remove tinted or silicone sunscreen on its own.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly describe the cleanser as hydrating and non-stripping, leaving skin soft, though one reports dry flakes surfacing faster than with other hydrating cleansers and another had to stop due to barrier stripping.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as lightweight, gentle, and effective at leaving skin hydrated and clean.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation, reduced redness, and relief for eczema-prone areas, but several others with sensitive skin describe hives, redness, itching, or a damaged barrier from the same product.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature/dry-sensitive skin reports minimized forehead lines after switching to this cleanser as the only routine change.

concerns.aging: One mature-skin reviewer reports forehead lines minimizing after consistent use, attributed to the cleanser alone.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe skin left soft, hydrated, and not stripped; one dry-skin reviewer instead reports dry flakes appearing faster than with other hydrating cleansers, and another with dry, sensitive skin had to discontinue due to barrier stripping.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the cleanser leaves skin red, irritated, or with an itchy rash; others with reactive or eczema-prone skin report calming effects and no irritation.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers say the product avoids stripping and even helps heal barrier issues, but at least two reviewers with sensitive or dry-acne-prone skin report the cleanser stripped or damaged their barrier.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the cleanser cleared hormonal body acne after long-term struggle, while another with sensitive skin reports it broke her out in hives on the face.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or combination-acne skin report clear, non-stripping cleansing with no new breakouts; however, three reviewers report new breakouts, closed comedones, or cystic pimples on the face, back, shoulders, and neck, with one asking for reformulation to remove a specific pore-clogging ingredient.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report it removes oil effectively without leaving residue or worsening clogged pores, with one specifying it does not fully remove tinted or silicone sunscreen alone.

aspects.libelle: Large bottle, good value for price

extraits.texte: I normally have no issues with cocokind products so I really wanted to like this cleanser. But it did the opposite of what it said it would do for me. I have quite sensitive skin and this made me break out in hives on my face every time I used it and really damaged my skin barrier, overall. Not willing to risk it as a body cleanser so I will he returning.

extraits.titre: Cocokind Milky-Soft Face and Body Wash
extraits.texte: I wanted to love this, but it broke me out so bad. Pimples all over my back, shoulders, and neck. My face got a lot more texture as well, kp and closed Comodones :( Really frustrating, wouldn't recommend if you are acne prone.

I heard such amazing things about this product and wanted to love it…. Ive been looking for a cleanser that is gentle, but leaves my face feeling clean. Unfortunately, after consistent use for a few weeks, this really stripped my barrier to the point i have to stop. I would not suggest this for someone with dry, sensitive, acne prone skin

I'm a cocokind regular, and was excited to try this cleanser. It is exactly what my dry and sensitive skin has needed, so much so that some lines on my forehead have minimized. It's the only change I made in my routine, and my skin is so soft (and not dry) that the lines are disappearing. I wasn't expecting this, and it is why I came to write a review. I only gave it 4 stars because the coconut ingredient smell (not coconut scent) is a bit overpowering for me. I'll continue to use it and just not breathe it in, but wanted to mention it for others who are sensitive to smells.

extraits.titre: Works surprisingly well on oily skin
extraits.texte: I have very oily skin, yet feel like strong/stripping cleansers can make things worse. I've tried my share of creamy, non-foaming, or gentle cleansers but they always leave a film behind which does not work with my oily skin and leaves me prone to more clogged pores. I decided to try this based on a video where the CEO of cocokind explained this left no film behind, yet foamed and removed oil. The feel of this is amazing. My skin can get really irritated and this is simultaneously as gentle as can be while also very cleansing. Removed all oil, left no film behind, and the value is great for the size tube. This will be my go to cleanser morning & night (except a couple times a week I'll use an exfoliating cleanser with acids at night). But this is holy grail status for sure. So are their moisturizers, which are all I'll use. I love their blue moisturizer (water gel one) as well as the texture smoothing cream for ultra dry days when it's 10 degrees out and even my oily skin needs more than the water based one. Everything is soooo gentle and non irritating. Skincare should never be harsh and as a 90s kid I've had to unlearn that (back then us oily gals were given stridex, alcohol based wipes, and cleansers harsher than dish soap lol)

Only product that has worked for my extreme body acne! I have hormonal body acne ive used every body cleaner you can think of (im 25 yrs old) ive struggle with body acne since i was 18 and this has been working amazing! My body loves it and its showing. Ive been using this for 1 month now.

I've struggled with acne for probably 6 years. I've gone to the dermatologist for my skin and have been prescribed retinoids and other topical creams and medication. They helped clear my skin for a bit but it never prevented my acne and I would continue to get a lot of severe breakouts. That was until I tried this serum and I absolutely SWEAR by it. This product has gotten rid of a lot of my redness from scarring, and calms down my breakouts almost immediately. I've also noticed that I've had smoother skin. It also works really well with other topical creams if you use them. I've never had any sort of bad reaction. I can't imagine not having this serum in my routine!
